hints.content:
The **constant of proportionality** is the value of $y$ when $x=1$ in a proportional relationship.

On which line does $y=3$ when $x=1$?

[[☃ image 1]]


Line $\blueD{A}$ has a constant of proportionality of $3$ between $x$ and $y$.
